source: BIP-39 test mnemonic of vectors/identity-derivation.json; each party role is a distinct pair context from the listed relationship nonce — no key is reused across roles

roles.note: ack/voucher keys are the CHANNEL tuples (8.1): M_R/R_M = mediator-requester channel, M_T/T_M = mediator-target channel
roles.A_B: established relationship (star, mapping, profile, prior tuple of continuity)
roles.R_T: requester's fresh context toward the target
roles.T_I: target's fresh context toward the requester

self.label: group/uEiDYLnFbXqm2cwuJWuk9yNzRmlzWDpCTH6yA_4aP_1z_RA
self.note: the community anchor at generation 1: the group-context derivation over the personal community’s genesis digest (Identity 0.54 §2, §5.4; the S-DID cut of 0.13); the vector key name „self“ mirrors the frozen wire field spelling

payloads.note: payload-level POSITIVES with real Encounter 0.24 cards (eddsa-jcs-2022) — the former card-vector debt is discharged; cardDigest preimage = the complete card document including its proof (2.1)

negative.name: mapping-foreign-self
negative.fixture: addressee B holds tuple (A,B) active; arrival on that tuple
negative.checkOrder: 6.3 steps 1-8 in order; steps 1-4b PASS (MACs are over the mutated body), step 5 FAILS

negative.name: mapping-card-1
negative.checkOrder: 6.3 step 1 FAILS: the card is a self-card@1 (no commit), the mapping otherwise anchor-mapping@4; MACs are over this body
negative.expect: reject: the card of anchor-mapping@4 is a self-card@2

negative.name: mapping-lineage-not-ending-at-self
negative.fixture: addressee B holds tuple (A,B) active; arrival on that tuple
negative.checkOrder: 6.3 steps 1-4 PASS, step 4a FAILS: the lineage element verifies under both signatures and meets the binding of the generation-1 card, but its next is generation 2 while self is generation 1 (MACs are over the mutated body)
negative.expect: reject: the last next of lineage != self

negative.name: mapping-lineage-binding-broken
negative.fixture: addressee B holds tuple (A,B) active; arrival on that tuple
negative.checkOrder: 6.3 steps 1-4a PASS, step 4b FAILS at the binding alone: both elements verify under both signatures, each prev is the preceding next and the last next is self (the foreign generation 3 of anchor-rotation.json), but the binding computed over the second element's next is not the commit of the first element (MACs under the pair key and the foreign key verify)
negative.expect: reject: a lineage element whose next does not meet the binding the preceding element commits to

negative.name: mapping-lineage-65
negative.fixture: addressee B holds tuple (A,B) active; arrival on that tuple
negative.checkOrder: 6.3 step 1 FAILS: the lineage carries 65 elements, the schema admits at most 64; every element verifies, the bindings chain and the chain ends at self (generation 66)

negative.name: probe-shape-255
negative.expect: reject: blinded MUST have exactly 256 entries (6a.2)

negative.name: reply-wrong-request-digest
negative.fixture: requester holds the positive introductionRequest of this file for the same act
negative.checkOrder: schema PASS, signature PASS (freshly signed over the mutated body), then requestDigest comparison FAILS
negative.expect: reject: requestDigest does not match held request (8.2)

negative.name: legacy-version-3
negative.expect: reject: anchor-mapping@3 not implemented (Trust 0.31 2.1); its card is a self-card@1, its lineage carries anchor-rotation@1

negative.name: star-salt-replay
negative.fixture: recipient state: highest completed salt for tuple (A,B) = 1 (after accepting this file's star)

2.label: group/uEiDYLnFbXqm2cwuJWuk9yNzRmlzWDpCTH6yA_4aP_1z_RA/2
2.note: generation 2 of the same community anchor: group/<digest>/2 (Identity 0.54 §5.4)

4.label: group/uEiDYLnFbXqm2cwuJWuk9yNzRmlzWDpCTH6yA_4aP_1z_RA/4
4.note: generation 4: group/<digest>/4 — only its binding appears (the commit of the generation-3 card and of the rotation 2 → 3)

rotation.note: anchorMappingRotated: the sender A rotated its community anchor from generation 1 to 2 (anchorRotation) and re-issued the mapping on tuple (A,B) under a higher revision with lineage [anchorRotation]; B, holding anchorMapping (self = generation 1, its card committing to generation 2), checks that the binding computed over the first element's next equals that held binding (heldBinding) and classifies the mapping as a ROTATION (6.3 condition 8): the previously held self is the prev of a lineage element. The binding is computed as anchor-rotation.json states

lineageBound.note: anchorMappingLineage64: A at generation 66 of <D> (group/<D>/66) carries the 64 most recent rotations, 2→3 … 65→66, in chain order, each committing to the generation after its next (6.1, 6.3 conditions 4a and 4b); the card under generation 66 commits to generation 67; it verifies. A contact holding generation 2 finds it in the carried segment — a ROTATION; one holding generation 1 missed more than 64 rotations: the segment does not carry its held self as the prev of an element, so it REJECTS the mapping and keeps the anchor it holds (6.3 condition 8, 6170, 6400). The 65-element mapping is the negative mapping-lineage-65

starContact.label: group/uEiBu2zGmgfsWIoYWegoJalB3jkpavqPuMWTN7OTgBPixiQ
starContact.note: a contact C of A whose anchor-mapping@3 toward A, A has verified under 6.3 (fixture: that mapping lies outside this vector), so C is the one member of A's deliverable set toward B (2040). The star A → B blinds C's community anchor (5010); it never carries A's own community anchor `self`. C's anchor is group/<D_C> under the second-party IKM, HKDF-SHA-256(oracle IKM, salt empty, info "rltp/vector/second-party-root-ikm", 64 bytes); D_C = "u" || base64url(0x12 0x20 || SHA-256(UTF-8 of genesisPreimage)), a documented sample

chain3.note: anchorMappingGeneration3: A at generation 3 carries the chain 1 → 2 → 3 (anchorRotation, anchorRotation23) under revision 3; the second element's next meets the binding the first commits to, and the first element's next meets the binding of the generation-1 card B holds. The card under generation 3 commits to generation 4, as the last element does. B holding generation 1 or 2 classifies it as a ROTATION
